iterations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: complete independent pixel-art torso source for an animated SVG cow mascot.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the currently damaged isolated armless hoodie torso. Image 2 is a fabric and pixel-art STYLE reference of the original full hoodie; do not copy its long sleeves or cuffs.
Primary request: repair the first torso so it is a clean, fully drawn standalone asset. Preserve its frontal pose, body proportions, hood opening, crossed deep navy collar, cream drawstrings with cream square ends, chest mark, large kangaroo pocket, ribbed hem, and charcoal/navy pixel shading.
Repair the left shoulder: REMOVE the small detached-looking diagonal dark tab protruding to the left. Continue a smooth rounded shoulder contour directly into the torso. Repair both side edges, lower corners, and shoulder bases as solid fabric with a continuous dark outer outline. Fill every accidental transparent notch, white remnant, horizontal cut seam, missing fabric sliver, and clipped patch INSIDE the garment with coherent navy cloth and natural folds. The torso's interior must be solid except for the intentionally open collar area above it. Make both shoulders complete attachment surfaces for separate arm layers.
Text (verbatim): a white pixel "ZL" chest mark on the viewer's right, followed by a small bright cyan square.
Composition: ONE isolated torso, shoulders to hem, centered and fully visible with transparent margin. Keep approximately the same shoulder-to-hem height, chest width, neckline position, drawstring positions, logo position and pocket outline as Image 1. Do not enlarge the body or change the garment design. Retain the deliberately stair-stepped pixel-art edges; repair broken gaps, not the pixel aesthetic.
Constraints: the asset is the TORSO ONLY. No head, neck skin, arms, long sleeves, cuffs, wrists, hands, hooves, desk, laptop, objects, background, cast shadow, labels or watermark. No duplicated fabric overlays, detached fragments, holes, jagged cut artifacts, white side marks, or isolated pixels. Genuine transparent alpha background. Keep the same dark palette and pixel density as the references.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: isolated ARMLESS TORSO for a layered animated cow SVG.
Edit the provided newly repaired torso with ONE targeted correction: NARROW ONLY THE OUTER SIDE PANELS. The current shape mistakenly has long swollen sleeve-like columns on both sides, making it wider than the cow's existing torso. Remove those sleeve-like lobes and their elbow/sleeve folds. Replace them with clean, gently tapering, continuous torso side seams and short solid shoulder attachment edges.
Keep the central garment artwork fixed: original pixel style and palette, neckline/hood opening and collar, two cream drawstrings, exact white pixel "ZL" and cyan square, kangaroo pocket, ribbed hem, and their positions and sizes. Keep the shoulder-to-hem height the same. Keep the neck and central chest at the same scale. Do not compress or stretch the whole image. Only repaint the lateral fabric outside the central torso to a narrower silhouette.
Target proportions: the completed armless torso silhouette should be approximately as wide as it is tall (width to height about 1.00), rather than the current approximately 1.17. Both upper shoulders remain complete rounded attachment surfaces for separate arm assets. Side seams should continue from just outside those shoulder roots down to the waist, without hanging sleeves, elbows, cuffs or additional limbs.
The intended output is ONE fully drawn chest/waist hoodie body, not a whole hoodie with sleeves. No transparent holes, white garment remnants, protruding detached tabs, mask cuts, fragments or isolated pixels inside or along the body. Retain a crisp stair-stepped pixel outer contour. Do not add hands, arms, head, skin, objects, background, shadow, labels or watermark. Fully visible asset with transparent margins and genuine transparent alpha.
